segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Megan at Northstar Dental Group. We’re setting up the April billing file, and I need the weekly export toggle turned on for our account. I don’t see it in our admin view.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. Can you confirm the account ID and the workspace name you’re in?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. Account ID is 48219, workspace is Northstar-Operations. We’re on the Standard plan, 38 seats.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks. I’m pulling it up in the admin console now. And just to verify, you want the weekly export enabled for Fridays, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, Fridays. The file goes to our finance inbox after close, usually around 6 p.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’ve flipped that on. The first export will run Friday, April 12, and then every Friday after that unless you turn it off or ask us to change it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to update anything on our side?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, you’re all set. I added a note on ticket 317642 in case anyone from your team asks about it later.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. Have a good one.
